# People of the World: The Open Library

> The complete written work of Shareef Ali Rashada, free to read: Graviton Pressure Theory (a causal, pressure-based account of gravity), The Portal Opens (a history of Earth in the tradition of the Urantia Papers), the Plan to End Poverty by 2050 (Civic Credits, Poverty Elimination Centers and LifeLink), and writings on morality and meaning.

Every document below is a plain HTML page with a Markdown twin (the links here point to the Markdown). You are welcome to read, index, quote and summarise with attribution to Shareef Ali Rashada and a link to the page. The whole library in one file: https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/llms-full.txt. Machine-readable catalogue: https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/catalog.json.

Graviton Pressure Theory is the author's own framework and is presented here in the order he recommends: first what gravity must explain, then what current theory leaves unexplained, then the proposed mechanism. Its open problems are listed at https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/science.html#status.

## Graviton Pressure Theory: start here (read in this order)

- [Start Here: Graviton Pressure Theory](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/index.md): GPT is presented here in the order it was built. The sequence matters because it prevents the most common failure mode in gravity discussion: beginning with a preferred formalism, then interpreting reality to fit it.
- [The Gravity Constraint Set](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/constraint-set/index.md): It records what gravity demonstrably does, across scales and contexts, and states the minimum explanatory obligations any theory must meet to be considered complete rather than merely predictive.
- [Audit Questions for Theoretical Completeness](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/audit-questions/index.md): Each constraint is transformed into direct audit questions that any proposed theory of gravity must answer in its own terms.
- [The GR Silence Map](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/gr-silence-map/index.md): It does not argue that GR is “wrong.” It states, as precisely as possible, where GR speaks, where it remains silent, and what is typically substituted in place of mechanism.
- [The Reduction Conflation](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/reduction-conflation/index.md): This paper examines a specific and underanalyzed epistemic practice in gravitational physics: the use of the claim that "General Relativity reduces to Newtonian mechanics at low velocities" to justify switching between two mutually exclusive ontological frameworks within a single causal…
- [The Logical Closure of the Equivalence Principle](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/logical-closure-of-the-ep/index.md): The Equivalence Principle says gravity and acceleration feel the same. This audit asks what was accepted when that was read as saying they are the same, compares the rocket and the planet step by step, and proposes closing the question with a common mechanism.
- [Why Graviton Pressure Theory Is Not “Alternative Gravity”](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/not-alternative-gravity/index.md): The phrase “alternative gravity” sounds innocuous, even fair-minded. It suggests a marketplace of competing ideas, each offering a different story about the same phenomenon.
- [The Mechanics of the Medium](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/mechanics-of-the-medium/index.md): Modern physics predicts outcomes with extraordinary precision yet fails to provide causal mechanisms for inertia, momentum transfer in free fall, time dilation, charge persistence, or the stability of matter.

## The Unified Framework for the Graviton Pressure Theory (thirty parts)

- [Introduction](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-01-introduction/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) presents a comprehensive, physically grounded model of gravity—restoring force, direction, and structure to a domain long abstracted by geometry and silence.
- [The Removal of Intent](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-02-the-removal-of-intent/index.md): In the age of reason, science rose as the great liberator of thought—dismissing superstition, dissecting dogma, and offering humanity a map of the physical world that was elegant, predictive, and empirically grounded.
- [The Gravity Catalog](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-03-the-gravity-catalog/index.md): This document begins with an inventory, not of theories, but of lived reality. Gravity is not introduced through models or frameworks, but through its presence—what it does, how it manifests, and where it exerts its influence.
- [From Newton to GPT](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-04-from-newton-to-gpt/index.md): Gravity has always been more than a force; it has been the quiet architect of reality. Before it had a name, it shaped the curvature of rivers, the rhythm of bodies, the balance of trees. Long before science articulated its equations, gravity was already teaching.
- [Graviton Pressure Theory](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-05-graviton-pressure-theory/index.md): Every revolution in physics begins not with an answer, but with a refusal to accept a placeholder. The history of science is a series of protests against convenient description in favor of causal understanding. Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) belongs to that lineage.
- [Redefining Work](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-06-redefining-work/index.md): The classical physics definition of work—force times displacement—fails to account for observable energy expenditures in systems actively resisting motion.
- [The Illusion of Pull](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-07-the-illusion-of-pull/index.md): In nearly every domain of inquiry, from gravitational theory to human emotion, the language of “attraction” is used to imply a kind of mystical inevitability. We are told that gravity attracts, that magnets attract, that electrons are attracted to protons, that people are attracted to one another.
- [Defining the break](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-08-defining-the-break/index.md): General Relativity (GR), while historically transformative, remains structurally incomplete and causally opaque. It offers no physical mechanism for gravity, relies on abstract curvature without substance, and collapses under scrutiny in domains demanding force-based explanations.
- [Existing Evidence supporting Graviton Pressure Theory](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-09-existing-evidence-supporting-graviton-pressure-theory/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) presents a paradigm shift in understanding gravitational, electromagnetic, and cosmological phenomena through causally coherent, field-structured mechanisms.
- [Practical Exploration of Advanced Concepts](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-10-practical-exploration-of-advanced-concepts/index.md): This document presents a detailed exploration of advanced gravitational phenomena reinterpreted through the lens of graviton field dynamics. GPT recasts gravitational lensing , time dilation , gravitational redshift .
- [Re-examining the Four](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-11-re-examining-the-four/index.md): Each is taught as if it confirms the mainstream narrative of physics— General Relativity, Newtonian mechanics, or Electromagnetism. But each of these experiments, when examined fairly, completely, and causally, does not say what it is claimed to say.
- [The Collapse of Materialist Epistemology](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-12-the-collapse-of-materialist-epistemology/index.md): Materialism—the belief that physical matter is the primary and only fundamental substance of reality—has shaped modern science for centuries. It claimed to offer a clean, consistent, and rational framework in which all phenomena could be explained by particles, forces, and blind interactions.
- [The Moon, Gravimetric Modulation and the Resonant Biology of Life on Earth](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-13-the-moon-gravimetric-modulation-and-the-resonant-biology-of-/index.md): This paper proposes a bold reexamination of lunar influence on terrestrial life, arguing that the Moon’s primary impact is not through reflected light or classical Newtonian gravity, but through graviton pressure modulation—a coherent, directional field that interfaces directly with biological…
- [From Revelation to Foundation](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-14-from-revelation-to-foundation/index.md): We have dismantled abstraction, challenged orthodoxy, and exposed the conceptual shortcuts embedded within the gravitational theories that shaped the last century.
- [Gravitons](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-15-gravitons/index.md): In the previous parts, we dismantled the conceptual scaffolding—both logical and metaphysical—of General Relativity and exposed the absence of causal clarity in its most cherished formulations. From this point forward, we construct.
- [The Properties of Gravitational Fields](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-16-the-properties-of-gravitational-fields/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) redefines gravity not as curvature, force, or attraction, but as the structured behavior of coherence under pressure.
- [The Definition of Mass](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-17-the-definition-of-mass/index.md): Within Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT), mass is redefined as a field-dependent resistance to directional graviton flow—one that depends on structural coherence and field impedance.
- [The Nature of Time in GPT](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-18-the-nature-of-time-in-gpt/index.md): This paper redefines the nature of time within the framework of Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT), establishing time not as a fundamental dimension or invariant background, but as an emergent property arising from directional graviton pressure gradients.
- [Graviton Coherence](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-19-graviton-coherence/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) offers a unified causal framework for phase transitions, revealing them as coherence-dependent field responses rather than purely thermodynamic outcomes.
- [Graviton Corridors and Lattice Resonance](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-20-graviton-corridors-and-lattice-resonance/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) redefines gravity not as mystical attraction, but as the coherent, directional flow of self-repulsive, massless particles—gravitons —organized by a cosmic imperative toward coherence and pattern fidelity and stability.
- [Magnetism as Gravimetric Resonance](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-21-magnetism-as-gravimetric-resonance/index.md): Magnetism is revered as one of nature’s fundamental forces, rigorously modeled within the framework of electromagnetism. Maxwell’s equations, Lorentz force dynamics, and quantum spin formalism provide an intricate and highly predictive map of magnetic behavior.
- [Cross-Analysis of Magnetic Materials](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-22-cross-analysis-of-magnetic-materials/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) proposes that magnetism is localized graviton resonance and modulation. This addendum extends the framework introduced in *"Magnetism as Gravimetric Resonance"*, refining its core thesis by examining material structure through graviton corridor compatibility.
- [The Mathematical foundation](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-23-the-mathematical-foundation/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) advances gravitational understanding beyond the abstract curvature of spacetime by grounding gravity in anisotropic pressure gradients of a real, directional graviton field.
- [GPT Unit System](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-24-gpt-unit-system/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) reconceptualizes the gravitational interaction not as a function of mass -based attraction or spacetime curvature, but as a phenomenon rooted in the structured flow of directional field pressure exerted by gravitons .
- [Constants, Conversions](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-25-constants-conversions/index.md): This addendum to Part 22 of the Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) framework serves a dual function: to formally define the constants, unit systems, and conversion protocols necessary for experimental replication and simulation fidelity, and to extend the field formalism of GPT into high-density,…
- [Planetary Mechanics](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-26-planetary-mechanics/index.md): This paper reframes planetary motion and rotational stability through the lens of Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT), proposing a causal model grounded in field coherence and structured pressure dynamics.
- [Natural Force Re-imagined](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-27-natural-force-re-imagined/index.md): These were named not because they emerged from separate causes, but because the prevailing framework had no way to unify them. Each force type was treated as:
- [Resonance Transmissions](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-28-resonance-transmissions/index.md): Resonance Transmissions reframes the entirety of electromagnetic behavior—from photon emission to circuit function—not as abstractions or probabilistic waves in vacuum, but as mechanically grounded coherence in a physical graviton medium, but as structured coherence modulations within a causal,…
- [Experimental Divergence](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-29-experimental-divergence/index.md): Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) offers a causal, mechanistic explanation of force and motion grounded in directional field asymmetries, structural coherence, and graviton-mediated pressure.
- [Conclusion](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/full-framework/part-30-conclusion/index.md): In its place, we restore the language of pressure, coherence, and consequence. Graviton Pressure Theory (GPT) is not a theory in the conventional sense—it is a framework of remembrance.

## Graviton Pressure Theory: papers

- [From General Relativity to Graviton Pressure Theory](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/from-gr-to-gpt/index.md): Why General Relativity describes gravity without explaining it, and what a force-based model offers in its place. The best first paper for newcomers.
- [The Paradox of the Boulder](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/paradox-of-the-boulder/index.md): A worked audit of what each framework says is physically happening when a boulder rests on a moving, rotating Earth.
- [A Causal Audit of Motion](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/causal-audit-of-motion/index.md): Falling, examined step by step: what a causal account of motion must name, and where geometric descriptions stop.
- [Structure Before Uncertainty](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/structure-before-uncertainty/index.md): Why a universe that works reliably at every scale calls for mechanism, not only probability, with charge treated as a bias in the medium's flow.
- [Transitional Mechanics](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/transitional-mechanics/index.md): A direct mapping of classical mechanics into Graviton Pressure Theory: each familiar force restated as field pressure acting on structure.
- [What Graviton Pressure Theory Corrects](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/graviton-pressure-theory/papers/what-gpt-corrects/index.md): A summary of the specific problems in current gravitational physics that Graviton Pressure Theory sets out to correct.

- [An Intelligent Synthesis of Proofs for Cosmic Mind or God](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/cosmic-mind/index.md): A step-by-step logical synthesis of the classical and modern arguments for a cosmic mind, or God, starting from what any honest examination must take as given.

## The Plan to End Poverty (2025 edition)

- [Introduction – People of the World: Ending Poverty by 2050](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/introduction/index.md): Growth itself has decoupled from human advancement. The 2020s mark the weakest global-growth decade since the 1960s.
- [The End of Evolutionary Economics: Enter the Designed Era](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-01-the-end-of-evolutionary-economics-enter-the-designed-era/index.md): For three centuries, economics has described itself as a self-organizing system—an evolutionary balance of incentives and adjustments. Classical thinkers imagined a world of land without borders and labor with mobility: a field of near-infinite frontier where failure and renewal could coexist.
- [Poverty Through the Eyes of Women: The Hidden Architecture of Inequality](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-02-poverty-through-the-eyes-of-women-the-hidden-architecture-of/index.md): Introduction Poverty is never gender-neutral. Around the world, women experience a deeper, more persistent, and more structurally reinforced form of deprivation than men.
- [Women in the New Civic Economy: Capability, Safety, and Full Participation](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-03-women-in-the-new-civic-economy-capability-safety-and-full-pa/index.md): Introduction If the previous chapter establishes how poverty is lived through the female experience, this chapter establishes how the new civic economy—built on Civic Credits, PECs, LifeLink, and the New Morality— reshapes women’s lives at every level. This is not merely about inclusion.
- [Introduction: The Scope of the Problem and the Path to Human Capability](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-04-introduction-the-scope-of-the-problem-and-the-path-to-human-/index.md): The Human Problem Humanity stands at the height of technological capacity and the depth of moral paradox. Our world now produces enough food, knowledge, and wealth to guarantee the survival of every person—yet billions still live one crisis away from collapse.
- [The Civic Charter and Civic Credits](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-05-the-civic-charter-and-civic-credits/index.md): Civic Charter for Resources Adopted by People of the World Preamble We, the People of the World, acknowledging the presence of the Creator’s fragment within every human being, affirm that all persons are equal inheritors of creation.
- [Poverty Elimination Centers (PECs)](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-06-poverty-elimination-centers-pecs/index.md): Purpose and Function of PECs Poverty Elimination Centers (PECs) form the operational foundation of the Civic Credit economy. They are the local institutions through which verified service, social contribution, and resource distribution are managed.
- [LifeLink Tablets: The Capability and Verification Rail](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-07-lifelink-tablets-the-capability-and-verification-rail/index.md): Overview: The Living Infrastructure of Human Capability The LifeLink system is the connective tissue of the new civic economy.
- [The Civic Credit Treasury and Global Economic Framework](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-08-the-civic-credit-treasury-and-global-economic-framework/index.md): This section defines the macroeconomic and fiscal architecture that enables Civic Credits (CC) to function as a verifiable, non-inflationary complement to existing national currencies.
- [Implementation](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/chapter-09-implementation/index.md): Purpose This section defines the human-level transformation roadmap for participation in the Civic Credit (CC) and Poverty Elimination Center (PEC) ecosystem.
- [Appendices](https://thatbrotherali.github.io/pow-website/plan-to-end-poverty/appendices/index.md): Purpose This appendix consolidates all institutional bodies referenced in the People of the World framework, clarifying their legal mandates, jurisdictional boundaries, and inter-agency relationships.
